purpose: Teach: ヌード/ピュア/パンドラ/ノア/聖母/ジミー/スーザン/アンディ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、美術部でヌードデッサンの基礎学んでたな
lines.en: Riku — you learned the basics of life drawing in art club, didn't you.
lines.style: Light, almost teasing observation. Leans in slightly. Watching to see how he reacts. Confident but not cruel.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭テーマ「ピュア」って書いてたな、桜
lines.en: You wrote "Pure" as your culture festival theme, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet turn-around. Steady eye contact. Not accusatory — more like a gentle catch, returning her gaze with his own. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でパンドラの箱のたとえ覚えたな
lines.en: Riku — you learned the Pandora's box analogy in social studies, right.
lines.style: Continuing the thread. Rhythmic, measured. Building toward something. Not breaking eye contact. Voice slightly lower.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でノアの方舟習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You covered Noah's ark in social studies, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Matching her pace. Calm and deliberate. Each reference lands like a small piece of a puzzle. Voice even, almost methodical.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、美術で聖母子像描いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were drawing a Madonna and Child in art class.
lines.style: Pressing forward now. Less question, more statement. Voice doesn't rise at the end. Watching his face closely. Breath steady.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ジミー・キンメルのトーク番組観てたな、桜
lines.en: You watched Jimmy Kimmel's late-night talk show, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Small shift — less accusation, more genuine curiosity. Eyebrow lift. Almost amused. The reference is lighter, the tone softens slightly but stays sharp.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英語の物語でスーザンって名前出てきたな
lines.en: Riku — a girl named Susan showed up in your English story.
lines.style: Voice quickens slightly. Less theatrical. More direct. Like she's moving in for something. Quieter intensity. Not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、トイ・ストーリーのアンディ覚えてたろ、桜
lines.en: You remembered Andy from Toy Story, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Closes the pattern. Calm, almost tender underneath the observation. Breath slightly held — like waiting for him to understand what she's been building. Very still.
